title: 第25章 生灵根实验第26章 是成功了吧
slug: 快递通两界我带华夏全民修仙
content_zh:
李婉的这双手跟着她也真是吃苦了，原想着大学毕业就可以解放了，以后不用再拿笔了，没想到一头扎进修真界，每天一睁眼就有几百字的心得体会等着自己。
她手指上的茧子都写厚了。
除了手札，李婉这次只寄回了骨锥，其他的修炼资源都留在了身上。
刚刚脱离流林宗，她正是穷的时候，给老家寄特产搞研究固然重要，但是她如今在修真界的生存更重要。
如今可不是打肿脸充胖子的时候。
就在李婉收拾小包袱离开流林宗时。
常老在经过审批后，前往云省筹建了朱火灵果种植基地。
说是种植基地，其实目前也只有三棵李婉寄回来的朱火灵果植株，不过常老相信，经过努力，往后东国肯定能种出一大片朱火灵果林。
本地周围含有灵气，但含量很稀薄，完全没有办法供给朱火灵果的生长所需，所以将朱火灵果种植基地挪到含有灵气更为浓郁的地方，是板上钉钉的事情。
将实验基地也一起挪到灵气浓郁的省份的提议并非没人提过，但是李局听完后，想就没想就否定了这个提议。
李婉是在这里穿越的，那么就算这里的灵气再贫瘠，这个地方对于东国来说都是特殊的。
有这份特殊在，实验基地就不可能进行地址搬迁。
倒是各个种植基地和需要在有灵气环境中搞研究的分支基地可以设在云省、春省、青省等灵气浓郁的地方。
这一个月来，基地的符咒研究还是没有显著的进展，符咒研究小组的研究人员觉得，他们画符失败的主要原因是没有灵力，符咒研究想要进行下去，至少人类得掌握灵气转化为灵力的方法。
和符咒小组与之相反的是，马窑遗址的深入挖掘探测在短短的一个月内已经组建好了团队，并正式进入正轨。
国家对这个遗址非常重视，参与这个遗址再次深入研究的除了有全国著名的历史学家，功法组的部分人员也参与了进去，他们期望能够从这个遗址中解开那根骨锥和地星灵气的秘密。
不过目前遗址的研究进程刚开始，还没有头绪。
又到了收快递的日子，这次基地的人依旧早早的就等在原地。
拿到快递，快速的扫完李婉这次寄回的信后，李局脸上浮现出既自豪又心疼的表情。
总之脸色不是很好看。

王芬和李志强在一旁看得忧心惴惴，莫不是他们家婉婉出了什么事？
李局回过神来，对夫妻二人笑笑，“是出现了一点意外，不过李婉同志已经解决了。”
说着，将李婉自己一个人脱离流林宗跑去没人的山洞用骨锥刺入丹田凿灵根的事说了出来。
和李婉相关的信息现在在东国都是绝密信息，但是王芬和李志强作为李婉的父母，有权利在脱敏之后了解她的现状。
王芬听到自家孩子拿骨锥生生往丹田里捅时，眼泪瞬间就掉了下来，一度哭得差点晕厥过去。
这孩子，胆子太大了，什么事都敢干。
实验基地最忙碌的时刻，就是每月李婉寄东西回来那天。
这次李婉在信里说了，让老家不必给她回寄东西，她目前什么都不缺。
李局也知现代社会的东西寄过去，对李婉的帮助几近于零，便也不打算勉强了。
等种植基地里的朱火灵果培育成功，到时候再给李婉寄回去，也能给孩子提供些资源，减轻些负担。
李婉已经用行动证明了那根博物馆中的骨锥就是能够帮助人凿灵的神器，但使用此神器凿灵的过程极其痛苦和凶险。
做为一个军人，李局并不认真军中的战士们比李婉一个小姑娘还皮娇肉嫩，受不了骨锥凿灵的痛苦。
也不认为现代医学比修仙界的玉膏丹差，会造成不可挽救的后果。
他亲自吩咐自己的助手，“去军队里选十个人，五天后在首都医院进行凿灵测试。”
content_en:
Li Wan's hands were really hard to follow her. She originally thought that she would be liberated after graduating from college and would no longer have to hold a pen in the future. However, she did not expect to plunge into the world of cultivation and have hundreds of words of insights waiting for her every day when she opened her eyes.
The calluses on her fingers were thick.
Except for the notebook, Li Wan only sent back the bone awl this time, and kept all other cultivation resources with him.
She had just left the Liulin Sect and was in poverty. It was important to send special products to her hometown for research, but her survival in the world of cultivation was more important now.
Now is not the time to pretend to be fat.
Just when Li Wan packed up her small baggage and left Liulin Sect.
After obtaining the approval, Chang Lao went to Yun Province to prepare for the establishment of a Zhuhuo Lingguo planting base.
Although it is said to be a planting base, there are currently only three Zhuhuoling fruit plants sent back by Li Wan. However, Chang Lao believes that with hard work, Dongguo will be able to grow a large Zhuhuoling fruit forest in the future.
There is aura around the area, but the content is very thin, and there is no way to supply the growth needs of the Zhuhuo Lingguo. Therefore, it is a certainty to move the Zhuhuo Lingguo planting base to a place with a richer aura.
The proposal to move the experimental base to a province with strong spiritual energy was not mentioned by anyone, but after Director Li heard it, he rejected the proposal without thinking.
Li Wan traveled through time here, so no matter how poor the spiritual energy here is, this place is special to Dongguo.
With this special feature, it is impossible for the experimental base to relocate.
On the other hand, various planting bases and branch bases that need to conduct research in a spiritual environment can be located in places with strong spiritual energy such as Yun Province, Chun Province, and Qing Province.
In the past month, there has been no significant progress in the base's talisman research. Researchers from the talisman research team believe that the main reason for their failure in drawing talismans is the lack of spiritual power. If the research on talismans is to continue, at least humans must master the method of converting spiritual energy into spiritual power.
Contrary to the Talisman team, the team for in-depth excavation and exploration of the Mayao ruins has been formed in just one month and is officially on track.
The country attaches great importance to this site. In addition to the nationally renowned historians who participated in the in-depth study of this site, some members of the Cultivation Group also participated. They hope to unlock the secrets of the bone awl and the earth star aura from this site.
However, the research process on the ruins has just begun and there is no clue yet.
It was the day to collect express delivery again, and this time the people at the base were still waiting at the spot early.
After getting the express delivery and quickly scanning the letter Li Wan sent back this time, Director Li had a proud and distressed expression on his face.
Anyway, his face doesn't look very good.
Wang Fen and Li Zhiqiang looked on worriedly. Could it be that something happened to their family Wanwan?
Director Li came back to his senses and smiled at the couple, "There was an accident, but Comrade Li Wan has already solved it."
As he spoke, he told the story of Li Wan leaving the Liulin Sect alone and running to an uninhabited cave with a bone awl to pierce the Dantian and dig out the spiritual roots.
Information related to Li Wan is now top secret in Dongguo, but Wang Fen and Li Zhiqiang, as Li Wan's parents, have the right to know her current situation after desensitization.
When Wang Fen heard her child stabbing his pubic area with a bone awl, tears fell instantly, and she almost fainted from crying at one point.
This kid is so courageous that he dares to do anything.
The busiest time at the experimental base is the day when Li Wan returns from sending things every month.
This time Li Wan said in the letter that her hometown would not have to send her anything back, as she currently lacked nothing.
Director Li also knew that in modern society, sending things there would provide almost zero help to Li Wan, so he didn't intend to force it.
When the Zhuhuo Lingguo is successfully cultivated in the planting base, it will be sent back to Li Wan. It will also provide some resources for the children and reduce some of the burden.
Li Wan has proven with actions that Nagen MuseumThe bone awl in the book is an artifact that can help people dig out spirits, but the process of using this artifact to dig out spirits is extremely painful and dangerous.
As a soldier, Director Li didn't take it seriously. The soldiers in the army were more delicate and delicate than a little girl named Li Wan, and they couldn't bear the pain of bone awls.
I don’t think that modern medicine is worse than the jade elixir in the world of immortality and will cause irreparable consequences.
He personally ordered his assistants, "Go and select ten people from the army, and they will undergo a spirit-breaking test at the Capital Hospital in five days."
